caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass pitcher with a bulbous ribbed body, a round base, a curved handle, and a dark-colored (possibly metal) hinged lid with a decorative finial. The pitcher has blue and brownish tones, indicating its transparent and reflective glass surface. The handle is also made of glass and is attached to the side of the pitcher, curving from the neck to the body. The spout area is fitted with the dark-colored lid, which is shown in detail. Below and slightly to the right of the pitcher, there is a technical drawing in blue and black lines showing a top view and a partial sectional diagram of the lid and spout mechanism. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations.
